simple.meaning: שְׁדַר (shᵉdar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to endeavor.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 6:15. The surrounding contexts include Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁדַר (H7712) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁדַר (shᵉdar) / H7712 is traced through Daniel 6:15 with source-language evidence and verse context.
